text:
incidents-bot: :warning: Alert: Quality drop detected for tenant 'orbit-finance' on dedicated pool dp-42 after quantization profile rollout. Metric: structured_match_rate down 0.94 -> 0.66 across transaction templates. Paging eng_oncall_max and ml_repo_sam.

eng_oncall_max: on it. are customer routes failing or just degraded quality?

ml_repo_sam: running quick diffs now. q4-v3.0 was rolled at 2025-11-04T14:03:10Z as part of scheduled rollout. Early signs: tokenization offsets for currency/date fields mismatch, causing malformed confirmations.

sre_patel: is this tenant pinned to the new profile or did routing accidentally include them?

ml_repo_sam: looks like orbit-finance had opt-in flag enabled for experimental quant profiles. Others on dp-42 remained on q4-v2.9. This is tenant-scoped.

acct_zoe: orbit's support channel already has 3 reports of bad confirmations. we should confirm rollback plan and ETA before messaging them.

eng_oncall_max: agree. mitigation options: A) immediate routing rollback for orbit-finance B) create transient routing override to safe model C) apply targeted token mapping patch (riskier). Recommend A for fastest customer recovery.

infra_li: if we do rollback, we should avoid full pool restart. I can invalidate tenant KV and refresh mapping: POST /pools/dp-42/invalidate?tenant=orbit-finance. That clears per-tenant caches.

ml_repo_sam: rollback steps (manual):

```bash
# revert tenant routing to previous quant profile
redwood routing rollback --tenant orbit-finance --model redwood/gpt-turbo --quant q4-v2.9
# verify smoke
redwood eval run --tenant orbit-finance --suite orbit-transactions-smoke
```

eng_oncall_max: assign owners: @ml_repo_sam runs revert, @sre_patel monitors traces and error budgets, @infra_li stands by for cache ops. I'll draft a short customer note once we see smoke pass.

incidents-bot: Action started: routing-rollback by ml_repo_sam at 2790011280

ml_repo_sam: I pushed the rollback for orbit-finance now. kicking off smoke harness. approx 60s to results.

sre_patel: temporarily increased request logging for tenant id orbit-finance (24h) and added a trace filter for dp-42.

ml_repo_sam: smoke results: template-fill-check 93/100, date-currency-match 95/100, structured_match_rate 0.93. Looks back to baseline.

acct_zoe: sending preliminary message to orbit account team: "We've reverted your routing to the prior quantization profile and are monitoring. Please file any lingering examples to help triage." will cc support.

custsuccess_ana: orbit replied acknowledging and asked for a deeper RCA and whether they should disable opt-ins. recommending we offer to keep them on v2.9 until we finish tests.

eng_oncall_max: good. immediate mitigation done. next: RCA/longer term tasks. @ml_repo_sam can you list follow-ups?

ml_repo_sam: follow-ups: 1) reproduce regression locally with orbit's prompt corpus and q4-v3.0 2) add canary gating: disallow experimental quant profiles for tenants on dedicated pools unless explicit enterprise approval 3) add automatic rollback rule: if structured_match_rate delta > 0.20 within 10m for enterprise tenants, trigger automatic revert 4) update rollout playbook to include per-tenant opt-in audit. I'll open RN-612 with repro artifacts.

sre_patel: also recommend a temporary synthetic monitor for dp-42 with orbit-specific templates for 72h. I'll put that in.

infra_li: note: if we need to re-deploy the quant runtime we should coordinate maintenance window with orbit since they're enterprise. avoid silent changes to dedicated pools.

incidents-bot: oncall note: eng_oncall_max remains primary for next 3 hours.

ml_repo_sam: logging technical notes: suspected root cause = quant mapping table change in q4-v3.0 that altered subtoken alignment for currency tokens, causing shifted spans in structured outputs. Will attach tokenizer diffs in RN-612.

acct_zoe: good. offer made to orbit: stay on v2.9 until we finish full eval. they accepted.

custsuccess_ana: scheduling customer postmortem for next Tue, including ML lead and infra.

eng_oncall_max: we'll mark incident resolved after 1 hour of stable metrics and all customer tickets updated. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
